+  curriculum:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: ui

+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

+## Rust learning path
+
+Open `/apps/rust-learning-path` for four short Rust lessons with a CodeMirror editor,
+real compiler output, and exercise checks. Run the existing API alongside the UI;
+`POST /api/apps/rust/run` proxies manual runs to the public Rust Playground with
+payload limits, rate limits, timeouts, and caching. No additional service is needed.
+See [the Rust workshop guide](ui/src/apps/rust-learning-path/README.md) for checks,
+runner limits, and curriculum tests.
+
 ## Railway deployment
 
 Railway has separate `api` and `ui` services in the same production project so the UI can proxy requests to `api.railway.internal`. The UI is public; the API does not need a public domain.

+"""The only upstream-specific part of the Rust runner. Never execute code locally."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+import time
+
+import requests
+from django.core.cache import cache
+
+PLAYGROUND_URL = "https://play.rust-lang.org/execute"
+MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES = 256 * 1024
+
+
+class RunnerError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message, status=503):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.status = status
+
+
+def run_rust(*, code, mode):
+    payload = {
+        "channel": "stable", "edition": "2021", "mode": "debug",
+        "crateType": "bin", "tests": mode == "test", "backtrace": False, "code": code,
+    }
+    key = "rust:result:" + hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
+    cached = cache.get(key)
+    if cached is not None:
+        return cached
+    # A conservative per-cache concurrency cap also protects the public Playground.
+    if not cache.add("rust:running", True, timeout=15):
+        raise RunnerError("The Rust runner is busy. Please try again in a few seconds.", 429)
+    try:
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        with requests.post(PLAYGROUND_URL, json=payload, timeout=(2, 8), stream=True) as response:
+            if response.status_code == 429:
+                raise RunnerError("Rust Playground is busy. Please wait a minute and try again.", 429)
+            response.raise_for_status()
+            chunks = bytearray()
+            for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=8192):
+                chunks.extend(chunk)
+                if time.monotonic() - started > 10:
+                    raise RunnerError("The Rust run timed out. Try a smaller program or check for an endless loop.", 504)
+                if len(chunks) > MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES:
+                    raise RunnerError("Compiler output was too large. Reduce how much the program prints.", 502)
+            result = json.loads(chunks)
+        if (not isinstance(result, dict) or type(result.get("success")) is not bool
+                or not all(isinstance(result.get(field), str) for field in ("stdout", "stderr"))):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid runner result")
+        result = {field: result[field] for field in ("success", "stdout", "stderr")}
+        cache.set(key, result, timeout=300)
+        return result
+    except requests.Timeout as exc:
+        raise RunnerError("The Rust run timed out. Try again or check for an endless loop.", 504) from exc
+    except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise RunnerError("Rust Playground is unavailable. Your code is still here; please try again.", 502) from exc
+    finally:
+        cache.delete("rust:running")

+import json
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+import requests
+from django.core.cache import cache
+from django.test import SimpleTestCase
+
+from .runner import MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES, RunnerError, run_rust
+
+
+class RunEndpointTests(SimpleTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        cache.clear()
+
+    def post(self, data=None, **kwargs):
+        return self.client.post('/api/apps/rust/run', json.dumps(data if data is not None else {"code": "fn main() {}", "mode": "run"}), content_type='application/json', **kwargs)
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.views.run_rust')
+    def test_success_and_test_mode(self, runner):
+        runner.return_value = {"success": True, "stdout": "ok", "stderr": ""}
+        response = self.post({"code": "fn main() {}", "mode": "test", "url": "https://untrusted.invalid"})
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(response.json(), runner.return_value)
+        runner.assert_called_once_with(code="fn main() {}", mode="test")
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.views.run_rust')
+    def test_validation_does_not_contact_upstream(self, runner):
+        for data in [[], None, {}, {"code": 3, "mode": "run"}, {"code": " ", "mode": "run"}, {"code": "x", "mode": []}, {"code": "x", "mode": "release"}, {"code": "\ud800", "mode": "run"}]:
+            response = self.client.post('/api/apps/rust/run', json.dumps(data), content_type='application/json')
+            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
+        self.assertEqual(self.client.get('/api/apps/rust/run').status_code, 405)
+        self.assertEqual(self.client.post('/api/apps/rust/run', 'code', content_type='text/plain').status_code, 415)
+        self.assertEqual(self.client.post('/api/apps/rust/run', '{', content_type='application/json').status_code, 400)
+        self.assertEqual(self.post(HTTP_SEC_FETCH_SITE='cross-site').status_code, 403)
+        self.assertEqual(self.post({"code": "é" * 8193, "mode": "run"}).status_code, 413)
+        self.assertEqual(self.post({"code": "x" * 33000, "mode": "run"}).status_code, 413)
+        runner.assert_not_called()
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.views.run_rust')
+    def test_peer_rate_limit_ignores_forwarded_ip(self, runner):
+        runner.return_value = {"success": True, "stdout": "", "stderr": ""}
+        for n in range(12):
+            self.assertEqual(self.post(HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR=f'198.51.100.{n}').status_code, 200)
+        response = self.post()
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 429)
+        self.assertEqual(response['Retry-After'], '60')
+        self.assertEqual(runner.call_count, 12)
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.views.run_rust')
+    def test_global_rate_limit(self, runner):
+        runner.return_value = {"success": True, "stdout": "", "stderr": ""}
+        for n in range(60):
+            self.assertEqual(self.post(REMOTE_ADDR=f'198.51.100.{n}').status_code, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(self.post(REMOTE_ADDR='198.51.100.61').status_code, 429)
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.views.run_rust', side_effect=RunnerError('Timed out', 504))
+    def test_upstream_error_is_json(self, runner):
+        response = self.post()
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 504)
+        self.assertEqual(response.json(), {"error": "Timed out"})
+
+
+class PlaygroundTests(SimpleTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        cache.clear()
+
+    def response(self, data=None, status=200):
+        response = MagicMock()
+        response.__enter__.return_value = response
+        response.status_code = status
+        response.iter_content.return_value = [json.dumps(data or {"success": True, "stdout": "hello", "stderr": ""}).encode()]
+        return response
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.runner.requests.post')
+    def test_contract_and_cache_keys(self, post):
+        post.return_value = self.response()
+        first = run_rust(code='fn main() {}', mode='run')
+        self.assertEqual(run_rust(code='fn main() {}', mode='run'), first)
+        self.assertEqual(post.call_count, 1)
+        payload = post.call_args.kwargs['json']
+        self.assertEqual((payload['edition'], payload['channel'], payload['mode'], payload['tests']), ('2021', 'stable', 'debug', False))
+        self.assertEqual(post.call_args.kwargs['timeout'], (2, 8))
+        run_rust(code='fn main() {}', mode='test')
+        self.assertTrue(post.call_args.kwargs['json']['tests'])
+        self.assertEqual(post.call_count, 2)
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.runner.requests.post')
+    def test_compiler_failure_is_a_valid_result(self, post):
+        post.return_value = self.response({"success": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": "error[E0382]"})
+        self.assertFalse(run_rust(code='bad', mode='run')['success'])
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.runner.requests.post')
+    def test_upstream_failures_and_output_cap_release_lock(self, post):
+        for failure, expected in [(requests.Timeout(), 504), (requests.ConnectionError(), 502), (ValueError(), 502)]:
+            post.side_effect = failure
+            with self.assertRaises(RunnerError) as raised:
+                run_rust(code='bad', mode='run')
+            self.assertEqual(raised.exception.status, expected)
+            self.assertIsNone(cache.get('rust:running'))
+        post.side_effect = None
+        for data in [{"success": 'yes'}, [1], {"success": True, "stdout": None, "stderr": ''}]:
+            post.return_value = self.response(data)
+            with self.assertRaises(RunnerError):
+                run_rust(code='bad', mode='run')
+        post.return_value = self.response(status=429)
+        with self.assertRaises(RunnerError) as raised:
+            run_rust(code='bad', mode='run')
+        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.status, 429)
+        post.return_value = self.response()
+        post.return_value.iter_content.return_value = [b'x' * (MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES + 1)]
+        with self.assertRaises(RunnerError) as raised:
+            run_rust(code='bad', mode='run')
+        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.status, 502)
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.runner.requests.post')
+    def test_busy_runner_makes_no_upstream_call(self, post):
+        cache.set('rust:running', True)
+        with self.assertRaises(RunnerError) as raised:
+            run_rust(code='bad', mode='run')
+        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.status, 429)
+        post.assert_not_called()
+
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.runner.time.monotonic', side_effect=[0, 11])
+    @patch('apps.rust_learning_path.runner.requests.post')
+    def test_elapsed_timeout_releases_lock(self, post, clock):
+        post.return_value = self.response()
+        with self.assertRaises(RunnerError) as raised:
+            run_rust(code='slow', mode='run')
+        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.status, 504)
+        self.assertIsNone(cache.get('rust:running'))

+import hashlib
+import json
+import time
+
+from django.core.cache import cache
+from django.core.exceptions import RequestDataTooBig
+from django.http import JsonResponse
+from django.views.decorators.csrf import csrf_exempt
+from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST
+
+from .runner import RunnerError, run_rust
+
+MAX_CODE_BYTES = 16 * 1024
+MAX_BODY_BYTES = 32 * 1024
+
+
+def within_limit(key, limit):
+    key = f"rust:rate:{key}:{int(time.time() // 60)}"
+    if cache.add(key, 1, timeout=65):
+        return True
+    try:
+        return cache.incr(key) <= limit
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+
+# Anonymous, stateless execution: no cookie/session authority. JSON-only, no CORS,
+# and cross-site browser requests are rejected. Limits apply even to cached runs.
+@csrf_exempt
+@require_POST
+def run(request):
+    if request.headers.get("Sec-Fetch-Site") == "cross-site":
+        return JsonResponse({"error": "Run Rust from this app."}, status=403)
+    if request.content_type != "application/json":
+        return JsonResponse({"error": "Use application/json."}, status=415)
+    try:
+        if int(request.META.get("CONTENT_LENGTH") or 0) > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
+            raise RequestDataTooBig()
+        body = request.body
+        if len(body) > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
+            raise RequestDataTooBig()
+        data = json.loads(body)
+    except RequestDataTooBig:
+        return JsonResponse({"error": "The request is too large (32 KiB maximum)."}, status=413)
+    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
+        return JsonResponse({"error": "Send a valid JSON object."}, status=400)
+    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("code"), str) or not data["code"].strip():
+        return JsonResponse({"error": "Provide non-empty Rust code."}, status=400)
+    try:
+        code_bytes = data["code"].encode("utf-8")
+    except UnicodeEncodeError:
+        return JsonResponse({"error": "Code must be valid UTF-8 text."}, status=400)
+    if len(code_bytes) > MAX_CODE_BYTES:
+        return JsonResponse({"error": "Code is limited to 16 KiB."}, status=413)
+    if data.get("mode") not in ("run", "test"):
+        return JsonResponse({"error": "Mode must be run or test."}, status=400)
+    # Do not trust caller-supplied X-Forwarded-For. Behind a proxy, its clients
+    # share this budget; the global budget remains effective in either case.
+    peer = hashlib.sha256(request.META.get("REMOTE_ADDR", "unknown").encode()).hexdigest()
+    if not within_limit(peer, 12) or not within_limit("global", 60):
+        response = JsonResponse({"error": "Too many runs. Wait a minute before trying again."}, status=429)
+        response["Retry-After"] = "60"
+        return response
+    try:
+        return JsonResponse(run_rust(code=data["code"], mode=data["mode"]))
+    except RunnerError as exc:
+        response = JsonResponse({"error": str(exc)}, status=exc.status)
+        if exc.status == 429:
+            response["Retry-After"] = "60"
+        return response

+# Rust workshop
+
+Four atomic lessons for issue #62's day-one PoC: Hello Rust, immutable bindings,
+functions, and moves. Ownership has two checks: deliberately produce E0382, then
+repair the move with `clone()`. A lesson completes only after all its checks pass.
+
+Open `/apps/rust-learning-path` in the shared UI. The shared Django API must be
+running for execution (`npm run dev` proxies `/api` to localhost:8000). No new
+service, database, account, migration, or Railway configuration is required.
+
+## Content and checks
+
+Chapter JSON in `lessons/` is discovered and sorted by `catalog.js`. Stable lesson
+IDs also work as URL hashes. Each lesson declares edition 2021. `diagnostic` is an
+optional first exercise with its own starter, solution, task, hint, and check.
+
+- `stdout`: successful execution and trimmed output equals `expected`; optional
+  `requires` tokens provide lightweight feedback on the concept being practiced.
+- `compile_error`: unsuccessful execution and a matching `error[E....]` diagnostic.
+- `tests`: append the checked-in `#[cfg(test)]` harness outside the editable code,
+  execute in test mode, and require a successful non-empty test run.
+
+These are learning checks, not a tamper-proof grading system. Tests are bundled
+with the UI and inspectable. Drafts and completion are kept only in React state
+for the current visit. Quizzes, persistent progress, search, exports, and the
+remaining curriculum are outside this PoC.
+
+CodeMirror is shared with Three.js through `src/components/CodeEditor.jsx`, with
+Rust language support and a 16px editor. Run is manual, with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter,
+clickable compiler locations, hints, reset, and solutions. On phones the panes
+stack, the symbol row scrolls inside its panel, and Run stays at the bottom.
+Editing or navigating cancels stale responses; editing revokes that exercise's
+completion until its check passes again.
+
+## Execution boundary
+
+`runRust({code, mode, signal})` only calls `POST /api/apps/rust/run`. Django's
+`apps/rust_learning_path/runner.py` is the sole Playground adapter. It sends
+`channel=stable`, `edition=2021`, `mode=debug`, `crateType=bin`, and `tests=true`
+only for test mode to `https://play.rust-lang.org/execute`. The Playground controls
+the live stable compiler version; curriculum CI pins rustc **1.85.0**. Code runs
+on the public Playground, never on the Django host. Do not put secrets in lessons.
+
+The anonymous endpoint requires JSON and rejects cross-site browser fetches. It
+has a 16 KiB UTF-8 code limit (including tests), a 32 KiB request limit, 12 requests
+per minute per peer and 60 globally, one active upstream run per cache, a five-minute
+result cache, and a 256 KiB upstream-response cap. Limits apply before cache hits.
+Connection/read timeouts are 2/8 seconds with an elapsed-time check while reading;
+the browser aborts after 12 seconds. An aborted browser run may continue upstream
+until its server timeout. There are no automatic retries.
+
+Limits and locks use Django's configured cache. The default LocMemCache is
+**per process**, so budgets multiply across workers/replicas. The server uses
+REMOTE_ADDR, not untrusted X-Forwarded-For; browsers behind the same proxy may
+share a budget. This deliberately conservative PoC needs a shared cache and a
+trusted proxy identity policy before scaling usage. Only cache keys contain hashes,
+not source code. Results are briefly cached in memory; the app does not log code.
+
+## Verification
+
+- `npm test`: validates JSON and check behavior.
+- `npm run test:rust`: runs every starter and solution with local rustc 1.85.0
+  (or `RUSTC=/absolute/path/to/rustc`). Starters must fail their intended check;
+  every solution must pass. Only repository fixtures are executed locally.
+- `npm run test:browser -- rust-learning-path.spec.js`: deterministic API fixtures
+  test manual execution, all check types, compiler links, errors, cancellation,
+  and 1440px / 390px layouts without contacting the Playground.
+- `python manage.py test apps.rust_learning_path` from `api/`: validates limits,
+  cache/adapter behavior, malformed inputs, and upstream failures with mocks.
+
+`.github/workflows/test-rust.yml` runs the real compiler checks and browser tests;
+the existing API workflow discovers the backend tests. CI does not send workloads
+to the public Playground. Live availability still requires an occasional manual
+end-to-end smoke check with the API running.

description.body: Implements the day-one PoC from #62: a new gallery app at `/apps/rust-learning-path` where learners edit Rust, run it manually, and receive real compiler output and exercise feedback. - Four lessons cover hello world, mutable bindings, functions, and ownership. Ownership includes both an expected E0382 error and its repair, exercising stdout, compile-error, and test checks. - Reuses the CodeMirror editor with Rust highlighting; adds clickable compiler locations, hints, solutions, cancellation of stale results, and a phone layout with symbol keys and a sticky Run button. - Adds `POST /api/apps/rust/run` to the existing Django API. The Playground adapter enforces payload/output limits, timeouts, rate limits, short-lived caching, and an upstream concurrency limit. No new Railway service or infrastructure is required. - Adds CI that compiles every starter and solution with rustc 1.85.0, plus backend coverage. CI does not call the public Playground. Validation after rebasing onto current master: 21 UI tests, production build, all 10 starter/solution compiler checks and 113 Django tests passed. Rust and Three.js browser tests and the CI browser execution steps have been removed as requested. All five solution exercises passed a user-approved live Django-to-Playground check. Scope and limits: progress and drafts last for the current visit; the remaining curriculum, quizzes, persistent progress, search, and export are outside this PoC. Playground uses its current stable compiler with edition 2021. Rate limits and concurrency use the configured Django cache; the default cache is per worker, and users behind a proxy share its peer budget. Closes #62. ## Screenshots ### Desktop · 1440px ![Rust workshop on desktop, with lesson, Rust editor, and passing output check](https://github.com/tomahim/vibe-code-apps/blob/3d87b51e2d9746bc3ff909c153b9ad27ed4e0e83/docs/screenshots/rust-learning-desktop.png?raw=true) ### Mobile · 390px
